displayPattern: Outdoor control display reads EE (ASXC/DSXC/GSXC AC and ASZC/DSZC/GSZC heat pump outdoor units with the integrated control module)
meaning: Board misoperation: the manual lists welded compressor relay contacts as the error condition.
causes: Wires landed on the wrong terminals
diySteps: Technician: check that all wires are landed on the correct terminals; if not, turn off power, correct them and power the system back on
Technician: if wiring is correct, replace the board
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: this needs control board and wiring diagnosis.
sourceTitle: Service and Troubleshooting: ASXC/DSXC/GSXC condensing units and ASZC/DSZC/GSZC heat pumps (RS6200007 r27, hosted by Daikin Comfort)
